about_the_game:
Run your own restaurant in the snowy Alaskan town of Frosthaven while enjoying immersive fishing adventures. Start with basic gear—an old fishing rod, a classic reel, and simple bait—and catch fish to cook and sell in your restaurant. Use your earnings to upgrade your equipment, expand your menu, and hire staff to help manage your restaurant efficiently.

Master various fishing techniques, including float, spinning, and feeder, to catch a wide range of fish. Customize your restaurant menu and decor to attract more customers and become the town’s favorite dining spot.

Explore Frosthaven’s frozen lakes, calm rivers, and hidden fishing locations. Use vehicles or rent boats to reach remote areas. Switch between first-person view for fishing and top-down view for managing your restaurant.

Play solo or meet other anglers in multiplayer mode, participate in tournaments, or challenge friends to fishing duels. Frosthaven offers a relaxing yet rewarding experience in Alaska’s breathtaking wilderness—catch fish, manage your restaurant, hire staff, and become the heart of the town.

Key Features

  • Multiple fishing methods: float, spinning, feeder

  • Wide variety of baits and lures

  • Cook and sell fish in your restaurant

  • Customize restaurant menu and decor

  • Switch between first-person and top-down views

  • Single-player and multiplayer modes

  • Face-to-face interaction system with other players

  • Fishing duels and tournaments

  • Rent or own boats for remote fishing spots

  • Vehicles for fast travel around the town

  • Rest points and tents for convenience

  • Hire staff to help run your restaurant

  • Discover unique fish species across different locations

  • Customer satisfaction and restaurant rating system

name: FROSTHAVEN - Fishing & Restaurant Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel i3 7th, AMD Ryzen 1xxx series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 or RX 550
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated GPUs require additional 2GB of system RAM. These estimates may change in the final release.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel i5 7th, AMD Ryzen 3xxx series
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080 or RX 6600
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated GPUs require additional 2GB of system RAM. These estimates may change in the final release.

short_description: Run your own restaurant in the snowy town of Frosthaven, Alaska, and experience a fishing and restaurant simulator. Catch fish in first-person, manage your restaurant, cook and sell your catch, and become the town’s top angler and restaurateur.
